method: Every page 1–36 was individually visually inspected at 120 dpi in the initial PDF. The nine changed final pages were individually visually re-inspected. The remaining 27 final images were independently verified byte-identical by SHA256 to the inspected initial images. Checked exhibit legibility, text and mathematics clipping, rendered references and statement page breaks.
